current_role: Partner at Cohen Klingenstein; chairman of the Claremont Institute
summary: Thomas Klingenstein (born 1954) is a partner in the investment firm Cohen Klingenstein and has chaired the Claremont Institute since 2010; his family fund has given Claremont more than $19M since 2005. His Thomas D. Klingenstein Fund is among the funders of the Edmund Burke Foundation, which runs the NatCon conferences. He gave more than $10M in the 2024 election cycle.
